costumeConcept.description: Personalized Revengeance-style precision cyborg: olive/charcoal layered ceramic armor, exposed braided actuators and genuinely articulated mechanical limbs, stronger black anatomical-left arm assembly recalling her long sleeve, olive anatomical-right precision hand, shoulder/cheek interfaces designed for her conventional sniper rifle, low-profile backpack and practical articulated boots. No generic shiny cloth, no Raiden body copy, no extra limbs.
identityCodes: Adult MGSV Quiet natural recognizable face and tied-back chestnut hair; no Raiden identity, artificial jaw or silver hair imported.

Personal olive/charcoal mechanical plates and braided exposed actuators; stronger anatomical-left black arm structure recalls her long sleeve, while the anatomical-right precision hand remains olive. Entire torso and limbs are engineered cybernetic reconstruction, with genuine articulated mechanical joints and practical boots, not clothing printed with circuitry.
Low-profile shoulder and cheek interfaces accommodate her conventional MGSV custom Wicked Butterfly sniper silhouette; no fantasy energy weapon, extra arm or copied Raiden body.

limits: Root physically inspected all32-source pose contacts, weapon-point zooms where applicable, six native neutral/KO head-torso-boot witnesses and same-scale KO comparison. Artists physically inspected all original source PNGs. No hidden anatomy or exact retail animation is certified.

All source facings are independently drawn with two contact-keypose walks, not mirrored or an asserted complete retail cycle. Manual pelvis/sole origins retain visible source-body axes; actual preview/movement/sizing and source-to-world emissions require game QA.

Only selected right/left KO14 logical aliases use the accepted visual display calibration: Liquid355/390 or Quiet480/475. Other30roles, native PNGs, points, combat timings and resources are unchanged. Boss306/297neutral calibration stays unchanged. This is a qualified global visual compromise based on native head/torso/boots and rendered comparison, not a certified anatomical transfer or bitmap editing.

Liquid remains the same adult MGS1 shirtless rooftop incarnation, redrawn as Next Gen; it already had nextgen family coverage and must not count as a newly covered franchise character/family. No coat/era fusion.

The Boss Metal Gear and Quiet cyborg are user-requested original character adaptations, not official alternate costumes. Boss is fully mechanical ivory/black armour/sensor head, no human face or hair. Quiet uses personalized Revengeance mechanical construction while retaining adult MGSV identity.

Quiet custom Wicked Butterfly is reference-based and closest in overall barrel/scope/chassis silhouette; fine receiver/stock geometry is less exact than the original capture and not certified1:1. Actual VS shoot projectile moves deliberately use native rifle role11, preserving original actionMap, timings and stats. Core dash/other actual moves require separate mode checks.

All weapon ports belong to the selected physical native role11, with independently inspected muzzle/rear axes; no generic screen-coordinate muzzle. Source review is not admission to Support/Core or a projectile profile replacement.

Only two previously inspected original rifle reference capture URLs are added to complete mandatory provenance. Source SHA/native art/geometry/roles/points/plans/profiles are unchanged. URLs identify IMFDB-hosted original-game screenshots, not generated identity authority for unseen surfaces.
